text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor m-e-r-g-e-d the c-a-s-e f-i-l-e a-n-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e u-n-d-e-r the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l m-a-t-t-e-r n-u-m-b-e-r.
2) the c-l-e-r-k l-e-f-t the c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t on f-i-l-e w-i-t-h the a-c-c-o-m-p-a-n-y-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n a-n-d the f-i-n-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t.
3) the r-e-v-i-e-w e-r-r-o-r was n-o-t l-o-g-g-e-d in the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k p-o-i-n-t u-n-r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d.
4) the s-t-a-t-u-s w-a-s m-a-r-k-e-d as c-o-n-c-l-u-d-e-d, a-n-d the i-t-e-m w-a-s r-e-m-o-v-e-d from the a-c-t-i-v-e q-u-e-u-e on t-h-e s-a-m-e d-a-y.
5) no f-u-r-t-h-e-r a-c-t-i-o-n w-a-s t-a-k-e-n, a-n-d the d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-e-r-e s-t-a-l-e-d in the c-l-o-s-e-d s-e-c-t-i-o-n of the r-e-c-o-r-d-s r-e-p-o-s-i-t-o-r-y.
